claims.assessment: approved Wang Pu's pitch method as matching Xiao-Shao

translationRepairs: Emperor Taizong of Tang restored the ancient tradition and had Zu Xiaosun and Zhang Wenshou revise the court music, so that the eighty-four circulatory modes reappeared and no instrument in the bell-chime ensemble remained mute. The An Lushan rebellion left the capital in ruins; scarcely one instrument or craftsman in ten survived, and the music performed grew ever more corrupt.

Emperor Taizong of Tang restored the ancient tradition and had Zu Xiaosun and Zhang Wenshou revise the court music, so that the eighty-four circulatory modes reappeared and no instrument in the bell-chime ensemble remained mute. The An and Shi rebellion left the capital in ruins; scarcely one instrument or craftsman in ten survived, and the music performed grew ever more corrupt.
s0054 has 安、史之亂, naming both An and Shi; the before text reduces this to An Lushan alone. The proposed "An and Shi rebellion" restores both names without other changes.
After the An Lushan rebellion, the heartland was laid waste.
After the An and Shi rebellion, the heartland was laid waste.
s0113 has 安、史亂離; the before text again names only An Lushan. "An and Shi rebellion" correctly reflects both rebels named in the Chinese.
Emperor Wu of Liang, himself expert in pitch theory, devised twelve four-way flutes to sound the eight categories of instruments.
Emperor Wu of Liang, himself expert in pitch theory, devised four sitong pitch-standards and twelve flutes to sound the eight categories of instruments.
s0103 自造四通十二笛 is four 通 (sitong pitch-standards) plus twelve flutes, not twelve "four-way" flutes. The proposed English correctly separates the two instrument types.

units.zh: 樂誌下
units.en: Treatise on Music, Part Two
units.literal: Music Treatise, Part Two

units.zh: 周廣順元年，太祖初即大位，惟新庶政，時太常卿邊蔚上疏請改舞名，其略云：「前朝改祖孝孫所定二舞名，文舞曰《治安之舞》，武舞曰《振德之舞》，今請改《治安》為《政和之舞》，《振德》為《善勝之舞》。
units.en: In the first year of Later Zhou's Guangshun reign, when Taizu first ascended the throne and set about renewing government, Director of Imperial Sacrifices Bian Wei memorialized the throne to rename certain court dances. In brief he wrote: "The previous dynasty had altered the two dances that Zu Xiaosun had established—the civil dance Pacifying the Realm and the martial dance Stirring Virtue. We ask that Pacifying the Realm be renamed Harmonious Governance and Stirring Virtue be renamed Good Victory.
units.literal: In the first year of Guangshun of Zhou, when the Taizu first assumed the great position and renewed all government affairs, at that time the Director of Imperial Sacrifices Bian Wei submitted a memorial requesting to change dance names. The gist said: "The previous dynasty changed the two dance names fixed by Zu Xiaosun: the civil dance was called Dance of Pacifying the Realm, the martial dance was called Dance of Stirring Virtue. We now request to change Pacifying the Realm to Dance of Harmonious Governance, and Stirring Virtue to Dance of Good Victory.

units.zh: 前朝改貞觀中二舞名，文舞曰《觀象之舞》，武舞曰《講功之舞》，今請改《觀象》為《崇德之舞》，《講功》為《象成之舞》。
units.en: He further noted that the previous dynasty had renamed two dances from the Zhenguan period—the civil Observing the Images and the martial Expounding Merit—and asked that Observing the Images become Honoring Virtue and Expounding Merit become Image Accomplished.
units.literal: The previous dynasty also changed the two dance names of the Zhenguan era: the civil dance was called Dance of Observing the Images, the martial dance was called Dance of Expounding Merit. We now request to change Observing the Images to Dance of Honoring Virtue, and Expounding Merit to Dance of Image Accomplished.

units.zh: 又議改《十二成》，今改為順。
units.en: He also proposed retitling the Twelve Accomplishments suite, substituting shun ("accord") for cheng ("accomplishment") throughout.
units.literal: He also discussed changing the Twelve Accomplishments, now to substitute shun (accord) in their titles.

units.zh: 《十二順樂曲》名：祭天神奏《禋成》，請改為《昭順之樂》；
units.en: Among the Twelve Shun pieces: for sacrifices to Heaven, where Yin Accomplished was played, he asked that it be renamed Zhao Shun;
units.literal: Names of the Twelve Shun music pieces: when sacrificing to Heaven, Yin Accomplished is played; request to change it to Zhao Shun music;

units.zh: 祭地祗奏《順成》，請改為《寧順之樂》；
units.en: for sacrifices to earthly spirits, where Shun Accomplished was played, he asked that it be renamed Ning Shun;
units.literal: when sacrificing to earthly spirits, Shun Accomplished is played; request to change it to Ning Shun music;

units.zh: 祭宗廟奏《裕成》，請改為《肅順之樂》；
units.en: for ancestral temple sacrifices, where Yu Accomplished was played, he asked that it be renamed Su Shun;
units.literal: when sacrificing at the ancestral temple, Yu Accomplished is played; request to change it to Su Shun music;

units.zh: 祭天地、宗廟，登歌奏《肅成》，今請改為《感順之樂》；
units.en: for sacrifices to Heaven, Earth, and the ancestral temple, where the ascending hymn Su Accomplished was used, he asked that it be renamed Gan Shun;
units.literal: when sacrificing to Heaven and Earth and the ancestral temple, the ascending song plays Su Accomplished; we now request to change it to Gan Shun music;

units.zh: 皇帝臨軒奏《政成》，請改為《治順之樂》；
units.en: when the emperor held court, where Zheng Accomplished was played, he asked that it be renamed Zhi Shun;
units.literal: when the emperor presides at the hall, Zheng Accomplished is played; request to change it to Zhi Shun music;

units.zh: 王公出入奏《弼成》，請改為《忠順之樂》；
units.en: when princes and dukes entered and left the palace, where Bi Accomplished was played, he asked that it be renamed Zhong Shun;
units.literal: when princes and dukes enter and exit, Bi Accomplished is played; request to change it to Zhong Shun music;

units.zh: 皇帝食舉奏《德成》，請改為《康順之樂》；
units.en: at the emperor's meals, where De Accomplished was played, he asked that it be renamed Kang Shun;
units.literal: when the emperor's meal is served, De Accomplished is played; request to change it to Kang Shun music;

units.zh: 皇帝受朝、皇后入宮奏《扆成》，請改為《雍順之樂》；
units.en: when the emperor received court and the empress entered the palace, where Yi Accomplished was played, he asked that it be renamed Yong Shun;
units.literal: when the emperor receives the court assembly and the empress enters the palace, Yi Accomplished is played; request to change it to Yong Shun music;

units.zh: 皇太子軒懸出入奏《胤成》，請改為《溫順之樂》；
units.en: when the crown prince entered and left with his full bell ensemble, where Yin Accomplished was played, he asked that it be renamed Wen Shun;
units.literal: when the crown prince with suspended bells enters and exits, Yin Accomplished is played; request to change it to Wen Shun music;

units.zh: 元日、冬至皇帝禮會，登歌奏《慶成》，請改為《禮順之樂》；
units.en: at the emperor's New Year and winter solstice assemblies, where the ascending hymn Qing Accomplished was used, he asked that it be renamed Li Shun;
units.literal: on New Year's Day and the winter solstice at the emperor's ceremonial assembly, the ascending song plays Qing Accomplished; request to change it to Li Shun music;

units.zh: 郊廟俎入奏《骍成》，請改為《禋順之樂》；
units.en: when sacrificial stands were brought in at suburban and temple rites, where Xing Accomplished was played, he asked that it be renamed Yin Shun;
units.literal: when the sacrificial stands enter at suburban and temple rites, Xing Accomplished is played; request to change it to Yin Shun music;

units.zh: 皇帝祭享、酌獻、讀祝及飲福、受胙奏《壽成》，請改為《福順之樂》。
units.en: during the emperor's sacrificial offering, libation, reading of prayers, drinking of the blessing wine, and receiving of sacrificial meat, where Shou Accomplished was played, he asked that it be renamed Fu Shun.
units.literal: when the emperor offers sacrifice, pours libation, reads the prayer, drinks the blessing, and receives the sacrificial meat, Shou Accomplished is played; request to change it to Fu Shun music.

units.zh: 梁武帝改《九夏》為《十二雅》，以協陽律、陰呂、十二管旋宮之義，祖孝孫改為《十二和》。
units.en: Emperor Wu of Liang had replaced the Nine Summers with the Twelve Elegances to align with the yang pitches, yin notes, and the twelve-pipe system of circulatory tonality; Zu Xiaosun later renamed them the Twelve Harmonies.
units.literal: Emperor Wu of Liang changed the Nine Summers to the Twelve Elegances, to accord with the meaning of yang pitches, yin notes, and the twelve tubes of circulatory tonality; Zu Xiaosun changed them to the Twelve Harmonies.

units.zh: 開元中，乃益三和，前朝去二和，改一雅。
units.en: During the Kaiyuan reign three pieces were added to the Harmonies; the previous dynasty removed two Harmonies and retitled one Elegance.
units.literal: In the Kaiyuan era three harmonies were added; the previous dynasty removed two harmonies and changed one elegance.

units.zh: 今去雅，只用《十二順》之曲。
units.en: He proposed dropping the Elegances altogether and using only the Twelve Shun pieces.
units.literal: Now the elegances are removed, and only the Twelve Shun pieces are used.

units.zh: 祭孔宣父、齊太公廟降神奏《師雅》，請同用《禮順之樂》；
units.en: for spirit-descent rites at the temples of Confucius and Duke Tai of Qi, where Master Elegance was played, he asked that Li Shun be used instead;
units.literal: when invoking the spirits at the temples of Confucius and Duke Tai of Qi, Master Elegance is played; request likewise to use Li Shun music;

units.zh: 三公升殿、會訖下階履行同用《弼成》，請同用《忠順之樂》；
units.en: when the three highest ministers ascended the hall and when they left after an assembly, both occasions used Bi Accomplished; he asked that Zhong Shun be used for both;
units.literal: when the three dukes ascend the hall, and when the assembly ends and they descend the steps to walk, Bi Accomplished is used for both; request likewise to use Zhong Shun music;

units.zh: 享先農及籍田同用《順成》，請同用《寧順之樂》。」
units.en: offerings to the spirit of agriculture and the ceremonial plowing both used Shun Accomplished; he asked that Ning Shun be used for both."
units.literal: offerings to the spirit of agriculture and the plowing ceremony both use Shun Accomplished; request likewise to use Ning Shun music."

units.zh: 曲詞文多不載。
units.en: The lyrics of these pieces are largely omitted from the record.
units.literal: The texts of the song lyrics are mostly not recorded.

units.zh: 〈（《五代會要》：邊蔚請添召樂師，令在寺習樂。
units.en: (According to the Institutional History of the Five Dynasties: Bian Wei asked to recruit additional music masters and have them train at the Directorate of Sacrifices.
units.literal: (Institutional History of the Five Dynasties: Bian Wei requested to recruit additional music masters and have them practice music at the temple.

units.zh: 敕太常寺見管兩京雅樂節級樂工共四十人外，更添六十人，內三十八人宜抽教坊貼部樂官兼充，餘二十二人宜令本寺照名充填。
units.en: An edict directed that beyond the forty graded court musicians already under the Directorate in both capitals, sixty more were to be added—thirty-eight drawn from attached chiefs of the Music Bureau to serve concurrently, and the remaining twenty-two filled from the directorate's own roster.
units.literal: An edict ordered that beyond the forty graded musicians of court music in the two capitals already under the Directorate of Sacrifices, sixty more were to be added; of these, thirty-eight should be drawn from the Music Bureau's attached section chiefs to serve concurrently, and the remaining twenty-two should be filled by name from the directorate itself.

units.zh: 仍令三司定支春冬衣糧，月報聞奏。
units.en: The Three Departments were to set their spring and winter clothing and grain allowances, with monthly reports to the throne.
units.literal: The Three Departments were also ordered to fix spring and winter clothing and grain allowances, with monthly reports submitted to the throne.

units.zh: 其舊管四十人，亦量添請。）〉
units.en: The existing staff of forty were likewise to receive proportionate increases in allowance.)〉
units.literal: The original forty under its charge were also to receive proportional increases in allowance.)〉

units.zh: 世宗顯德元年即位，有司上太祖廟室酌獻，奏《明德之舞》。
units.en: When Emperor Shizong ascended the throne in the first year of Xiande, the responsible officials offered libations at Taizu's temple hall to the accompaniment of the Dance of Bright Virtue.
units.literal: When Shizong assumed the throne in the first year of Xiande, the responsible officials presented libations at the Taizu temple hall, and the Dance of Bright Virtue was performed.

units.zh: 五年六月，命中書舍人竇儼參詳太常雅樂。
units.en: In the sixth month of his fifth year, he ordered Secretariat Drafter Dou Yi to review the directorate's court music.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the fifth year, the Secretariat Drafter Dou Yi was ordered to examine and revise the court music of the Directorate of Sacrifices.

units.zh: 十一月，翰林學士竇儼上疏論禮樂刑政之源，其一曰：「請依《唐會要》所分門類，上自五帝，迄於聖朝，凡所施為，悉命編次，凡關禮樂，無有闕漏，名之曰大周通禮，俾禮院掌之。」
units.en: In the eleventh month, Hanlin Academician Dou Yi memorialized on the foundations of ritual, music, penal law, and governance. His first proposal read: "Following the topical divisions of the Tang Institutional Compendium, let everything enacted from the age of the Five Emperors down to our own dynasty be compiled in full, with nothing omitted concerning ritual and music. Call the work Comprehensive Rites of Great Zhou and place it under the Ritual Office."
units.literal: In the eleventh month, Hanlin Academician Dou Yi submitted a memorial discussing the origins of ritual, music, penal law, and government. The first proposal said: "We request that according to the categories divided in the Tang Institutional Compendium, from the Five Emperors down to the sacred dynasty, all that has been enacted be ordered for compilation; everything pertaining to ritual and music, without omission, is to be named Comprehensive Rites of Great Zhou, and entrusted to the Ritual Office for custody."

units.zh: 其二曰：「伏請命博通之士，上自五帝，迄於聖朝，凡樂章沿革，總次編錄，系於歷代樂錄之後，永為定式，名之曰大周正樂，俾樂寺掌之。
units.en: His second proposal read: "I humbly ask that learned scholars compile the entire history of musical pieces from the Five Emperors to our dynasty, arranged in order and appended to the music records of previous ages as a permanent standard, to be called Correct Music of Great Zhou and placed under the Music Directorate.
units.literal: The second said: "We humbly request that broadly learned scholars be appointed, from the Five Emperors down to the sacred dynasty, to compile in full order all changes in musical pieces, appended after the music records of successive dynasties, to serve permanently as the fixed standard, named Correct Music of Great Zhou, and entrusted to the Music Directorate for custody.

units.zh: 依文教習，務在齊肅。」
units.en: Training should follow the written scores, with uniformity and solemnity as the goal."
units.literal: Instruction is to follow the text, with the aim of uniformity and solemnity."

units.zh: 詔曰：「竇儼所上封章，備陳政要，舉當今之急務，疾近世之因循，器識可嘉，辭理甚當，故能立事，無愧蒞官。
units.en: An edict replied: "Dou Yi's memorial sets forth the essentials of governance, identifies the urgent tasks of our day, and deplores the slavish conformity of recent times. His judgment is commendable and his reasoning sound; he is fit to take on such work without disgracing his office.
units.literal: An edict said: "The sealed memorial submitted by Dou Yi sets forth the essentials of government in full, raises the urgent tasks of the present age, and deplores the routine conformity of recent times. His capacity and insight are commendable, and his reasoning is very apt; thus he can accomplish affairs without shame in holding office.

units.zh: 所請編集大周通禮、大周正樂，宜依。
units.en: His request to compile the Comprehensive Rites of Great Zhou and Correct Music of Great Zhou is approved.
units.literal: His request to compile the Comprehensive Rites of Great Zhou and Correct Music of Great Zhou is approved.

units.zh: 仍令於內外職官前資前名中，選擇文學之士，同共編集，具名以聞。
units.en: Literary scholars are to be chosen from among qualified officials inside and outside the court to join the compilation, and their names reported to the throne.
units.literal: Let literary scholars be selected from among civil and military officials of prior qualification and prior appointment to compile together, and their names reported in full.

units.zh: 委儼總領其事。
units.en: Dou Yi was placed in overall charge of the project.
units.literal: Dou Yi is entrusted to take overall charge of the matter.

units.zh: 所須紙筆，下有司供給。」
units.en: Paper and writing materials are to be supplied by the appropriate offices."
units.literal: Paper and brushes required are to be supplied by the responsible offices."

units.zh: 六年春正月，樞密使王樸奉詔詳定雅樂十二律旋相為宮之法，並造律準，上之。
units.en: In the first month of spring of his sixth year, Privy Council Commissioner Wang Pu was ordered to work out the method by which the twelve court-music pitches circulate as tonics, and to construct a pitch standard, which he then presented to the throne.
units.literal: In the first month of spring of the sixth year, Privy Council Commissioner Wang Pu, by imperial order, thoroughly determined the method by which the twelve pitches of court music circulate as tonics, and also constructed a pitch standard, which he presented to the throne.

units.zh: 其奏疏略曰：
units.en: His memorial, in summary, read:
units.literal: His memorial in summary said:

units.zh: 夫樂作於人心，成聲於物，聲氣既和，反感於人心者也。
units.en: Music originates in the human heart and takes shape as sound through physical instruments; once sound and breath are harmonized, they move the heart in turn.
units.literal: Music arises in the human heart and becomes sound through things; once sound and breath are harmonized, they in turn affect the human heart.

units.zh: 所假之物，大小有數。
units.en: The instruments used for this have fixed proportions of large and small.
units.literal: The things borrowed for this purpose have determinate large and small measures.

units.zh: 九者，成數也，是以黃帝吹九寸之管，得黃鐘之聲，為樂之端也。
units.en: Nine is the number of completion; the Yellow Emperor therefore blew a nine-inch tube, obtained the yellow-bell pitch, and thereby established the foundation of music.
units.literal: Nine is the number of completion; therefore the Yellow Emperor blew a nine-inch tube and obtained the sound of yellow bell, which is the beginning of music.

units.zh: 半之，清聲也。
units.en: Halving the length yields the higher, clear pitch.
units.literal: Halving it produces the clear sound.

units.zh: 倍之，緩聲也。
units.en: Doubling the length yields the lower, slow pitch.
units.literal: Doubling it produces the slow sound.

units.zh: 三分其一以損益之，相生之聲也。
units.en: Adding or subtracting one-third of the length produces the mutually generating pitches.
units.literal: Taking away or adding one-third produces the mutually generating sounds.

units.zh: 十二變而復黃鐘，聲之總數也。
units.en: After twelve transformations the cycle returns to yellow bell—the full set of pitches.
units.literal: After twelve transformations one returns to yellow bell; this is the total number of sounds.

units.zh: 乃命之曰十二律。
units.en: These were named the twelve standard pitches.
units.literal: These were then named the twelve pitches.

units.zh: 旋叠為均，均有七調，合八十四調，播之於八音，著之於歌頌。
units.en: Arranged in rotation they form tonal keys; each key has seven modes, for eighty-four modes in all, distributed among the eight categories of instruments and embodied in songs and hymns.
units.literal: Arranged in rotation they form keys; each key has seven modes, totaling eighty-four modes, spread among the eight kinds of sound and fixed in songs and hymns.

units.zh: 宗周而上，率由斯道，自秦而下，旋宮聲廢。
units.en: From the Zhou founders onward, all followed this system; from the Qin dynasty downward, circulatory tonality fell into disuse.
units.literal: From the Zhou founders upward, all followed this Way; from Qin downward, circulatory tonality was abandoned.

units.zh: 洎東漢雖有大予丞鮑鄴興之，人亡而音息，無嗣續之者。
units.en: In the Eastern Han, Grand Music Master Bao Ye did revive it, but when he died the tradition died with him and no successor carried it on.
units.literal: By the Eastern Han, although Grand Music Master Bao Ye revived it, when the man perished the sound ceased, and there was no one to continue it.

units.zh: 漢至隋垂十代，凡數百年，所存者黃鐘之宮一調而已。
units.en: From Han through Sui, nearly ten dynasties and several centuries, only the single yellow-bell palace mode survived.
units.literal: From Han to Sui, spanning nearly ten dynasties and several hundred years, what survived was only the single mode of the yellow-bell palace.

units.zh: 十二律中，惟用七聲，其餘五律，謂之啞鐘，蓋不用故也。
units.en: Of the twelve pitches only seven were actually used; the remaining five were called "mute bells" because they had fallen silent.
units.literal: Of the twelve pitches only seven notes were used; the remaining five pitches were called mute bells, because they were not used.

units.zh: 唐太宗復古道，乃用祖孝孫、張文收考正雅樂，而旋宮八十四調復見於時，在懸之器，方無啞者，安、史之亂，京都為墟，器之與工，十不存一，所用歌奏，漸多紕繆。
units.en: Emperor Taizong of Tang restored the ancient tradition and had Zu Xiaosun and Zhang Wenshou revise the court music, so that the eighty-four circulatory modes reappeared and no instrument in the bell-chime ensemble remained mute. The An and Shi rebellion left the capital in ruins; scarcely one instrument or craftsman in ten survived, and the music performed grew ever more corrupt.
units.literal: Emperor Taizong of Tang restored the ancient Way and employed Zu Xiaosun and Zhang Wenshou to examine and correct court music, so that the eighty-four modes of circulatory tonality reappeared in the age; among suspended instruments there were finally no mute ones. In the rebellion of An and Shi the capital became ruins; of instruments and craftsmen not one in ten survived, and the songs and performances used grew increasingly erroneous.

units.zh: 逮乎黃巢之餘，工器都盡，購募不獲，文記亦亡，集官詳酌，終不知其制度。
units.en: After Huang Chao's rebellion, craftsmen and instruments were utterly lost; neither purchase nor recruitment could recover them, and the written records perished as well. Officials deliberated at length but could not recover the system.
units.literal: By the time of the aftermath of Huang Chao, craftsmen and instruments were utterly gone; purchase and recruitment obtained nothing, and written records were also lost. Officials were assembled for detailed deliberation, but in the end they did not know the system.

units.zh: 時有太常博士殷盈孫，案《周官·考工記》之文，鑄緌鐘十二，編鐘二百四十，處士蕭承訓校定石磬，今之在懸者是也。
units.en: Directorate academician Yin Yingsun then followed the Artificers' Records of the Offices of Zhou to cast twelve tassel bells and two hundred forty chime-bells, while recluse Xiao Chengxun calibrated the stone chimes—the very instruments that hang in the court ensemble today.
units.literal: At that time the Directorate of Sacrifices academician Yin Yingsun, following the text of the Offices of Zhou, Artificers' Records, cast twelve tassel bells and two hundred forty chime-bells; the recluse Xiao Chengxun calibrated the stone chimes—these are what hang in suspension today.

units.zh: 雖有樂器之狀，殊無相應之和。
units.en: The instruments had the right outward form, but produced no true harmonic correspondence.
units.literal: Although there was the form of musical instruments, there was utterly no corresponding harmony.

units.zh: 逮乎朱梁、後唐，歷晉與漢，皆享國不遠，未暇及於禮樂。
units.en: Under Later Liang, Later Tang, Later Jin, and Later Han, each regime was short-lived and had no leisure to restore ritual and music.
units.literal: By the time of Later Liang and Later Tang, passing through Jin and Han, all enjoyed the state for no long period and had no leisure to attend to ritual and music.

units.zh: 以至於十二緌鐘，不問聲律宮商，但循環而擊，編鐘、編磬徒懸而已。
units.en: The twelve tassel bells were struck in rotation without regard to pitch or mode; the chime-bells and stone chimes were mere ornaments hanging in the ensemble.
units.literal: Thus the twelve tassel bells were struck in rotation without regard to pitch, mode, or gong and shang; the chime-bells and stone chimes merely hung in suspension.

units.zh: 絲、竹、匏、土，僅有七聲，作黃鐘之宮一調，亦不和備，其餘八十三調，於是乎泯絕，樂之缺壞，無甚於今。
units.en: The string, bamboo, gourd, and clay instruments produced only seven notes in the single yellow-bell palace mode—and even that was imperfectly tuned. The other eighty-three modes had perished entirely; never has music fallen into such ruin as it has today.
units.literal: Silk, bamboo, gourd, and clay had only seven notes, performing the single mode of the yellow-bell palace, and even that was not harmoniously complete; the remaining eighty-three modes were thereby extinguished. Never has music been so ruined as today.

units.zh: 陛下天縱文武，奄宅中區，思復三代之風，臨視樂懸，親自考聽，知其亡失，深動上心。
units.en: Your Majesty, endowed with civil and martial gifts from Heaven, has taken the central realm and seeks to restore the culture of the Three Dynasties. Inspecting the court ensemble in person, you heard its losses for yourself and were deeply moved.
units.literal: Your Majesty is endowed by Heaven with civil and martial excellence, has taken possession of the central realm, and seeks to restore the customs of the Three Dynasties. Observing the suspended music, you personally examined and listened, knew its losses, and were deeply moved at heart.

units.zh: 乃命中書舍人竇儼參詳太常樂事，不逾月調品八音，粗加和會。
units.en: You then ordered Secretariat Drafter Dou Yi to review the directorate's music; within a month the eight categories of instruments were tuned into rough harmony.
units.literal: You then ordered Secretariat Drafter Dou Yi to examine the music affairs of the Directorate of Sacrifices; within a month the eight kinds of sound were tuned and roughly harmonized.

units.zh: 以臣嘗學律歷，宣示古今樂錄，令臣討論，臣雖不敏，敢不奉詔。
units.en: Because I have studied pitch theory and calendrics, I was shown the music records of past and present and ordered to investigate them. Though I am not clever, how could I refuse the command?
units.literal: Because your servant has studied pitch and calendrics, the music records ancient and modern were displayed and your servant was ordered to discuss them. Though your servant is not clever, how dare he not obey the edict?

units.zh: 遂依周法，以黍校定尺度，長九寸，虛徑三分，為黃鐘之管，與見在黃鐘之聲相應。
units.en: I followed Zhou methods, using millet grains to calibrate the measure—a tube nine inches long with an inner diameter of three tenths—and produced a yellow-bell pipe that matched the yellow-bell pitch already in use.
units.literal: I then followed Zhou methods, using millet to calibrate the measure: length nine inches, inner diameter three tenths, making the yellow-bell tube, which corresponded to the present yellow-bell sound.

units.zh: 以上下相生之法推之，得十二律管。
units.en: By the method of mutual generation I derived the full set of twelve pitch tubes.
units.literal: By the method of mutual generation above and below I derived twelve pitch tubes.

units.zh: 以為眾管互吹，用聲不便，乃作律準，十三弦宣聲，長九尺張弦，各如黃鐘之聲。
units.en: Because blowing many tubes against one another was impractical, I constructed a pitch standard—a nine-foot frame with thirteen strings, each tuned to the yellow-bell pitch.
units.literal: Considering that blowing many tubes against one another was inconvenient in use, I then made a pitch standard: thirteen strings to give forth sound, nine feet long with strings stretched, each like the yellow-bell sound.

units.zh: 以第八弦六尺，設柱為林鐘；
units.en: on the eighth string at six feet, a bridge was set for forest bell;
units.literal: on the eighth string at six feet, a bridge was set for forest bell;

units.zh: 第三弦八尺，設柱為大簇；
units.en: on the third string at eight feet, a bridge was set for great cluster;
units.literal: on the third string at eight feet, a bridge was set for great cluster;

units.zh: 第十弦五尺三寸四分，設柱為南呂；
units.en: on the tenth string at five feet, three inches, and four tenths, a bridge was set for southern lü;
units.literal: on the tenth string at five feet three inches and four tenths, a bridge was set for southern lü;

units.zh: 第五弦七尺一寸三分，設柱為姑洗；
units.en: on the fifth string at seven feet, one inch, and three tenths, a bridge was set for maiden wash;
units.literal: on the fifth string at seven feet one inch and three tenths, a bridge was set for maiden wash;

units.zh: 第十二弦四尺七寸五分，設柱為應鐘；
units.en: on the twelfth string at four feet, seven inches, and five tenths, a bridge was set for responding bell;
units.literal: on the twelfth string at four feet seven inches and five tenths, a bridge was set for responding bell;

units.zh: 第七弦六尺三寸三分，設柱為蕤賓；
units.en: on the seventh string at six feet, three inches, and three tenths, a bridge was set for luxuriant guest;
units.literal: on the seventh string at six feet three inches and three tenths, a bridge was set for luxuriant guest;

units.zh: 第二弦八尺四寸四分，設柱為太呂；
units.en: on the second string at eight feet, four inches, and four tenths, a bridge was set for great lü;
units.literal: on the second string at eight feet four inches and four tenths, a bridge was set for great lü;

units.zh: 第九弦五尺六寸三分，設柱為夷則；
units.en: on the ninth string at five feet, six inches, and three tenths, a bridge was set for yi rule;
units.literal: on the ninth string at five feet six inches and three tenths, a bridge was set for yi rule;

units.zh: 第四弦七尺五寸一分，設柱為夾鐘；
units.en: on the fourth string at seven feet, five inches, and one tenth, a bridge was set for pressed bell;
units.literal: on the fourth string at seven feet five inches and one tenth, a bridge was set for pressed bell;

units.zh: 第十一弦五尺一分，設柱為無射；
units.en: on the eleventh string at five feet and one inch, a bridge was set for wu she;
units.literal: on the eleventh string at five feet one inch, a bridge was set for wu she;

units.zh: 第六弦六尺六寸八分，設柱為中呂；
units.en: on the sixth string at six feet, six inches, and eight tenths, a bridge was set for central lü;
units.literal: on the sixth string at six feet six inches and eight tenths, a bridge was set for central lü;

units.zh: 第十三弦四尺五寸，設柱為黃鐘之清聲。
units.en: on the thirteenth string at four feet and five inches, a bridge was set for the higher octave of yellow bell.
units.literal: on the thirteenth string at four feet five inches, a bridge was set for the clear sound of yellow bell.

units.zh: 十二律中，旋用七聲為均，為均之主者，宮也，徵、商、羽、角、變宮、變徵次焉，發其均主之聲，歸乎本音之律，七聲叠應而不亂，乃成其調。
units.en: Among the twelve pitches, seven notes rotate as the basis of each key; gong is the governing note, followed by zhi, shang, yu, jue, and the altered tones. When the governing note sounds, it resolves to its home pitch; the seven notes answer one another in layers without confusion, and a mode is thereby formed.
units.literal: Among the twelve pitches, seven notes are used in rotation as keys; the lord of the key is gong, followed by zhi, shang, yu, jue, altered gong, and altered zhi. When the lord note of the key is sounded, it returns to its fundamental pitch; the seven notes respond in layers without disorder, and thus the mode is formed.

units.zh: 均有七調，聲有十二均，合八十四調，歌奏之曲，由之出焉。
units.en: Each key has seven modes, and there are twelve keys in all, yielding eighty-four modes from which all ceremonial songs and performances derive.
units.literal: Each key has seven modes; there are twelve keys in sound, totaling eighty-four modes; the pieces for song and performance issue from these.

units.zh: 伏以旋宮之聲久絕，一日而補，出臣獨見，恐未詳悉，望集百官及內外知音者較其得失，然後依調制曲。
units.en: Circulatory tonality has been lost for centuries; to restore it in a day on my judgment alone may not be adequate. I ask that officials and all who understand music inside and outside the court compare its strengths and flaws, and only then compose pieces according to the modes.
units.literal: We humbly consider that circulatory tonality has long been extinct; to restore it in a single day on the basis of your servant's solitary view may not be thorough. We hope that all officials and those inside and outside who understand pitch may compare its gains and losses, and only then compose pieces according to the modes.

units.zh: 八十四調，曲有數百，見存者九曲而已，皆謂之黃鐘之宮。
units.en: The eighty-four modes ought to comprise hundreds of pieces, yet only nine survive, and all are labeled yellow-bell palace.
units.literal: Of the eighty-four modes there should be hundreds of pieces; only nine survive today, and all are called the yellow-bell palace.

units.zh: 今詳其音數，內三曲即是黃鐘宮聲，其餘六曲，錯雜諸調，蓋傳習之誤也。
units.en: On examination, only three of the nine are genuinely in yellow-bell palace; the other six mix modes incorrectly—errors accumulated through transmission.
units.literal: Now examining their pitch numbers, three pieces are truly yellow-bell palace sound; the other six mix modes incorrectly, no doubt through errors in transmission and practice.

units.zh: 唐初雖有還宮之樂，至於用曲，多與禮文相違。
units.en: Early Tang did restore circulatory music, but the pieces actually used often contradicted ritual prescriptions.
units.literal: Although early Tang had music of restored circulatory tonality, in actual use the pieces mostly contravened ritual texts.

units.zh: 既不敢用唐為則，臣又懵學獨力，未能備究古今，亦望集多聞知禮文者，上本古曲，下順常道，定其義理。
units.en: Since Tang practice cannot serve as our standard, and I am too limited to investigate the full history alone, I also ask that learned scholars versed in ritual texts be assembled to ground the work in ancient pieces, align it with present practice, and settle the underlying principles.
units.literal: Since we dare not take Tang as the standard, and your servant is dull in learning and working alone, unable to investigate ancient and modern fully, we also hope to assemble those of broad learning who know ritual texts, to take ancient pieces as the root and follow present practice below, and fix their principles.

units.zh: 於何月行何禮，合用何調何曲，聲數長短，幾變幾成，議定而制曲，方可久長行用。
units.en: Which mode and piece belong to which month's rites, how many notes and transformations each requires—these must be settled before pieces are composed, if the system is to endure.
units.literal: For which month which rite is performed, which mode and piece should be used, the length of note numbers, how many transformations and completions—once these are deliberated and pieces composed accordingly, they may be used for long.

units.zh: 所補雅樂旋宮八十四調，並所定尺、所吹黃鐘管、所作律準，謹同上進。
units.en: I respectfully present the restored eighty-four circulatory modes of court music, together with the calibrated measure, the yellow-bell pipe, and the pitch standard I have constructed.
units.literal: The restored eighty-four modes of circulatory tonality in court music, together with the fixed measure, the yellow-bell tube blown, and the pitch standard constructed, are respectfully presented together to the throne.

units.zh: 世宗善之，詔尚書省集百官詳議。
units.en: Emperor Shizong approved the proposal and ordered the Department of State Affairs to convene all officials for full deliberation.
units.literal: Shizong approved it and ordered the Department of State Affairs to assemble all officials for detailed deliberation.

units.zh: 兵部尚書張昭等議曰：
units.en: Minister of War Zhang Zhao and others submitted their deliberation, saying:
units.literal: Minister of War Zhang Zhao and others deliberated, saying:

units.zh: 昔帝鴻氏之制樂也，將以範圍天地，協和人神，候八節之風聲，測四時之正氣。
units.en: When the Di Hong clan first established music, it was meant to encompass Heaven and Earth, harmonize humanity and the spirits, observe the winds of the eight seasonal nodes, and measure the correct qi of the four seasons.
units.literal: Of old, when the Di Hong clan established music, it was to bound Heaven and Earth, harmonize human beings and spirits, observe the wind sounds of the eight seasonal nodes, and measure the correct qi of the four seasons.

units.zh: 氣之清濁不可以筆授，聲之善否不可以口傳，故鳧氏鑄金，伶倫截竹。
units.en: The clarity and turbidity of qi cannot be conveyed in writing; the quality of sound cannot be passed on by word of mouth. Therefore the Fu clan cast bells and Ling Lun cut bamboo pipes.
units.literal: The clear and muddy of qi cannot be handed down by brush; the good and bad of sound cannot be transmitted by mouth. Therefore the Fu clan cast metal, and Ling Lun cut bamboo.

units.zh: 為律呂相生之算，宮商正和之音。
units.en: They worked out the mathematics of mutual pitch generation and the properly harmonized tones of gong and shang.
units.literal: They made the calculation of mutual generation among pitches, and the properly harmonized sounds of gong and shang.

units.zh: 乃播之於管弦，宣之於鐘石，然後覆載之情訢合，陰陽之氣和同，八風從律而不奸，五聲成文而不亂。
units.en: They spread the system among strings and pipes and proclaimed it on bells and stones; only then did the sentiments of Heaven and Earth unite, yin and yang harmonize, the eight winds follow the pitches without straying, and the five tones form ordered patterns.
units.literal: Then they spread it among strings and pipes and proclaimed it on bells and stones; only then did the feelings of that which covers and bears unite in joy, the qi of yin and yang harmonize, the eight winds follow the pitches without deviation, and the five sounds form patterns without disorder.

units.zh: 空桑、孤竹之韻，足以禮神；
units.en: the melodies of Kongsang and Guzhu sufficed to honor the spirits;
units.literal: the tones of Kongsang and Guzhu sufficed to honor the spirits;

units.zh: 《雲門》、《大夏》之容，無虧觀德。
units.en: the dances Cloud Gate and Great Xia did not fall short as displays of virtue.
units.literal: the forms of Cloud Gate and Great Xia did not fall short in displaying virtue.

units.zh: 然月律有旋宮之法，備於太師之職。
units.en: Yet the monthly pitches included the method of circulatory tonality, which fell within the Grand Music Master's charge.
units.literal: Yet the monthly pitches had the method of circulatory tonality, fully provided for in the office of the Grand Master.

units.zh: 經秦滅學，雅道淩夷。
units.en: When Qin suppressed learning, the elegant tradition declined.
units.literal: After Qin extinguished learning, the elegant Way declined.

units.zh: 漢初制氏所調，惟存鼓舞，旋宮十二均更用之法，世莫得聞。
units.en: In early Han only the Zhi clan's drum-and-dance music survived; the method of rotating among the twelve keys was lost to the world.
units.literal: In early Han what the Zhi clan tuned survived only as drum-and-dance; the method of rotating use among the twelve keys of circulatory tonality, the world could no longer hear.

units.zh: 漢元帝時，京房善《易》、別音，探求古義，以《周官》均法，每月更用五音，乃立準調，旋相為宮，成六十調。
units.en: Under Emperor Yuan of Han, Jing Fang, skilled in the Changes and expert in pitch, sought the ancient meaning and, following the key method of the Offices of Zhou, rotated the five notes month by month; he established a pitch standard, set the circulating tonics, and produced sixty modes.
units.literal: In the time of Emperor Yuan of Han, Jing Fang was skilled in the Changes and distinguished in pitch, sought ancient meaning, and by the key method of the Offices of Zhou changed use of the five notes each month; he then established a pitch standard, rotated as tonics, and formed sixty modes.

units.zh: 又以日法析為三百六十，傳於樂府，而編懸復舊，律呂無差。
units.en: He also divided the day-cycle into three hundred sixty parts and transmitted the system to the Music Bureau; the chime ensemble was restored and the pitches aligned without error.
units.literal: He also divided the day method into three hundred sixty parts, transmitted it to the Music Bureau, and the chime ensemble was restored to the old state, with pitches and notes without discrepancy.

units.zh: 遭漢中微，雅音淪缺，京房準法，屢有言者，事終不成。
units.en: When Han fell into mid-dynasty decline, elegant music was lost; advocates repeatedly urged adoption of Jing Fang's pitch-standard method, but the effort never succeeded.
units.literal: When Han declined in the middle period, elegant music was lost and deficient; Jing Fang's pitch-standard method was repeatedly advocated, but the matter in the end was not accomplished.

units.zh: 錢樂空記其名，沈重但條其說，六十律法，寂寥不傳。
units.en: Qian Yue recorded only names in vain; Shen Chong merely summarized the theories; the sixty pitch laws fell silent and were never transmitted.
units.literal: Qian Yue merely recorded their names in vain; Shen Chong only listed their theories; the sixty pitch laws were desolate and not transmitted.

units.zh: 梁武帝素精音律，自造四通十二笛，以鼓八音。
units.en: Emperor Wu of Liang, himself expert in pitch theory, devised four sitong pitch-standards and twelve flutes to sound the eight categories of instruments.
units.literal: Emperor Wu of Liang was by nature skilled in pitch and law; he himself made twelve four-way flutes to sound the eight kinds of tone.

units.zh: 又引古五正、二變之音，旋相為宮，得八十四調，與律準所調，音同數異。
units.en: He also applied the ancient five regular and two altered tones, rotating them as tonics to produce eighty-four modes—matching the pitch standard in sound though differing in numerical arrangement.
units.literal: He also drew on the ancient five regular and two altered notes, rotating as tonics to obtain eighty-four modes; with those tuned by the pitch standard, the sound was the same but the numbers differed.

units.zh: 侯景之亂，其音又絕，隋朝初定雅樂，群黨沮議，歷載不成。
units.en: Hou Jing's rebellion extinguished the tradition again; when Sui first sought to fix court music, factional obstruction delayed the work for years.
units.literal: In the rebellion of Hou Jing its music was again extinguished; when Sui first fixed court music, factions obstructed deliberation, and for years it was not accomplished.

units.zh: 而沛公鄭譯，因龜茲琵琶七音，以應月律，五正、二變，七調克諧，旋相為宮，復為八十四調。
units.en: Duke of Pei Zheng Yi then adapted the seven notes of Kucha pipa to the monthly pitches; combining the five regular and two altered tones into seven harmonious modes and rotating them as tonics, he restored the eighty-four modes.
units.literal: But Duke of Pei Zheng Yi, taking the seven notes of Kucha pipa, matched them to monthly pitches; the five regular and two altered notes, seven modes harmoniously joined, rotated as tonics, and again formed eighty-four modes.

units.zh: 工人萬寶常又減其絲數，稍令古淡。
units.en: The craftsman Wan Baochang further reduced the number of strings, giving the music a somewhat plainer, more archaic character.
units.literal: The craftsman Wan Baochang further reduced the number of strings, making it somewhat ancient and plain.

units.zh: 隋高祖不重雅樂，令儒官集議。
units.en: Emperor Gaozu of Sui did not esteem court music and ordered Confucian officials to deliberate the matter.
units.literal: Emperor Gaozu of Sui did not value court music and ordered Confucian officials to assemble for deliberation.

units.zh: 博士何妥駁奏，其鄭、萬所奏八十四調並廢。
units.en: Academician He Tuo submitted a counter-memorial, and the eighty-four modes proposed by Zheng and Wan were abolished entirely.
units.literal: Academician He Tuo submitted a refuting memorial, and the eighty-four modes presented by Zheng and Wan were all abolished.

units.zh: 隋氏郊廟所奏，惟黃鐘一均，與五郊迎氣，雜用蕤賓，但七調而已，其餘五鐘，懸而不作。
units.en: Sui suburban and temple music used only the yellow-bell key; the five suburban qi-welcoming rites mixed in luxuriant guest—seven modes in all—while the remaining five bells hung unused.
units.literal: What the Sui performed at suburban and temple rites was only the single key of yellow bell, and at the five suburban rites welcoming the qi, luxuriant guest was mixed in—only seven modes; the remaining five bells hung in suspension but were not struck.

units.zh: 三朝宴樂，用縵樂九部，迄於革命，未能改更。
units.en: Banquet music at the three courts relied on the nine divisions of slow music, and through the dynastic transition no change was made.
units.literal: For the three courts' banquet music, the nine divisions of slow music were used; down to the dynastic change, they could not be altered.

units.zh: 唐太宗爰命舊工祖孝孫、張文收整比鄭譯、萬寶常所均七音八十四調，方得絲管並施，鐘石俱奏，七始之音復振，四廂之韻皆調。
units.en: Emperor Taizong of Tang ordered veteran masters Zu Xiaosun and Zhang Wenshou to reconcile the seven-note, eighty-four-mode system of Zheng Yi and Wan Baochang; only then could strings and pipes sound together with bells and stones, the seven foundational tones revive, and harmony return to all four sides of the ensemble.
units.literal: Emperor Taizong of Tang then ordered the veteran craftsmen Zu Xiaosun and Zhang Wenshou to collate the seven notes and eighty-four modes harmonized by Zheng Yi and Wan Baochang; only then could strings and pipes be used together and bells and stones played together, the seven initial sounds revived, and the tones of the four sides all tuned.

units.zh: 自安、史亂離，鹹秦蕩覆。
units.en: After the An and Shi rebellion, the heartland was laid waste.
units.literal: From the separation of the An and Shi rebellion, all Qin lands were overturned.

units.zh: 崇牙樹羽之器，掃地無餘；
units.en: the lofty-toothed, feather-decked instruments were swept away without a trace;
units.literal: instruments with lofty teeth and planted feathers were swept clean, nothing remaining;

units.zh: 戛擊搏拊之工，窮年不嗣。
units.en: craftsmen skilled in tapping, striking, and clapping went years without successors.
units.literal: craftsmen of tapping, striking, and clapping went years without successors.

units.zh: 郊廟所奏，何異南箕，波蕩不遷，知音始絕。
units.en: suburban and temple performances were as meaningless as the southern Winnowing Basket constellation—adrift without direction, until those who understood music vanished entirely.
units.literal: what was performed at suburban and temple rites differed little from the southern Winnowing Basket; drifting without change, those who understood pitch were finally extinct.

units.zh: 臣等竊以音之所起，出自人心，夔、曠不能長存，人事不能常泰，人亡則音息，世亂則樂崩，若不深知禮樂之情，安能明制作之本。
units.en: We hold that music arises from the human heart; masters like Kui and Kuang cannot endure forever, and human affairs cannot always prosper—when men die, music falls silent; when the age is chaotic, music collapses. Without deep understanding of ritual and music, how can one grasp the foundations of cultural order?
units.literal: We your servants consider privately that where sound arises, it comes from the human heart; Kui and Kuang cannot long endure, human affairs cannot always be peaceful; when men perish sound ceases, when the age is chaotic music collapses—if one does not deeply know the sentiments of ritual and music, how can one clarify the root of establishment and regulation?

units.zh: 陛下心苞萬化，學富三雍。
units.en: Your Majesty's heart embraces all transformations, and your learning is steeped in the classics of the three Yong halls.
units.literal: Your Majesty's heart embraces the myriad transformations; your learning is rich in the three Yong halls.

units.zh: 觀兵耀武之功，已光鴻業；
units.en: your military achievements have already glorified the great enterprise;
units.literal: in displaying military achievement and martial glory, you have already illumined the great enterprise;

units.zh: 尊祖禮神之致，尤軫皇情。
units.en: your reverence for ancestors and the spirits moves your imperial heart above all.
units.literal: in honoring ancestors and worshipping spirits, your imperial feeling is especially moved.

units.zh: 乃眷奉常，痛淪樂職，親閱四懸之器，思復九奏之音，爰命廷臣，重調鐘律。
units.en: You turned to the Directorate of Sacrifices, grieved at the collapse of its musical duties, personally inspected the four suspended ensembles, sought to restore the ninefold performance, and ordered court ministers to retune the bells and pitches.
units.literal: You then turned affection to the Directorate of Constant Offerings, grieved at the fall of musical offices, personally inspected the four suspended ensembles, thought to restore the sound of nine performances, and thereupon ordered court ministers to retune bells and pitches.

units.zh: 樞密使王樸，采京房之準法，練梁武之通音，考鄭譯、寶常之七均，校孝孫、文收之九變，積黍累以審其度，聽聲詩以測其情，依權衡嘉量之前文，得備數和聲之大旨，施於鐘虡，足洽《簫韶》。
units.en: Privy Council Commissioner Wang Pu drew on Jing Fang's pitch standard, mastered Emperor Wu of Liang's universal tones, studied the seven keys of Zheng Yi and Wan Baochang and the nine transformations of Zu Xiaosun and Zhang Wenshou, calibrated measures with millet grains, tested pitches against the Sound Poems, followed ancient standards of weight and measure, recovered the principle of numbered harmony, and applied it to bells and stands until it matched the legendary Xiao-Shao music.
units.literal: Privy Council Commissioner Wang Pu adopted Jing Fang's pitch-standard method, mastered Emperor Wu of Liang's universal tones, examined the seven keys of Zheng Yi and Baochang, collated the nine transformations of Xiaosun and Wenshou, piled millet to verify the measure, listened to the Sound Poems to gauge the sentiment, followed the prior texts of weights and the fine measure, obtained the great purport of complete numbers and harmonized sound, applied it to bells and stands, and sufficed to accord with Xiao-Shao.

units.zh: 臣等今月十九日於太常寺集，命太樂令賈峻奏王樸新法黃鐘調七均，音律和諧，不相淩越。
units.en: On the nineteenth of this month we assembled at the Directorate and had Grand Music Master Jia Jun perform Wang Pu's new seven keys in yellow-bell mode; the pitches were harmonious, with no note overpowering another.
units.literal: We your servants on the nineteenth day of this month assembled at the Directorate of Sacrifices and ordered Grand Music Master Jia Jun to perform Wang Pu's new-method seven keys of the yellow-bell mode; pitches and notes were harmonious and did not encroach on one another.

units.zh: 其餘十一管諸調，望依新法教習，以備禮寺施用。
units.en: We ask that the remaining eleven pipes and their modes be taught by the new method, so the ritual directorate may put them into use.
units.literal: The remaining eleven tubes and various modes, we hope, will be taught according to the new method to prepare for use by the ritual directorate.

units.zh: 其五郊天地、宗廟、社稷、三朝大禮，合用十二管諸調，並載唐史、《開元禮》，近代常行。
units.en: The five suburban rites, sacrifices to Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temple, the altars of soil and grain, and the great ceremonies of the three courts all require the full twelve pipes and their modes, as recorded in Tang histories and the Kaiyuan Rites and practiced in recent times.
units.literal: For the five suburban rites, Heaven and Earth, ancestral temple, altars of soil and grain, and great rites of the three courts, all twelve tubes and various modes should be used together; these are recorded in Tang histories and the Kaiyuan Rites, and have been regularly practiced in recent times.

units.zh: 廣順中，太常卿邊蔚奉敕定前件祠祭朝會舞名、樂曲、歌詞，寺司合有薄籍，伏恐所定與新法曲調聲韻不協，請下太常寺檢詳校試。
units.en: During Guangshun, Director Bian Wei was ordered to fix the dance names, pieces, and lyrics for those sacrifices and assemblies; the directorate should hold the records on file. We fear they may not match the new pitch system and ask that the directorate examine and test them.
units.literal: In Guangshun, Director of Sacrifices Bian Wei, by imperial order, fixed the dance names, musical pieces, and song lyrics for the aforesaid sacrifices, assemblies, and court meetings; the directorate should have registers on file. We humbly fear that what was fixed may not accord in tune and sound with the new method, and request that the Directorate of Sacrifices be ordered to examine and test them in detail.

units.zh: 如或乖舛，請本寺依新法聲調，別撰樂章舞曲，令歌者誦習，永為一代之法，以光六樂之書。
units.en: If discrepancies are found, we ask the directorate to compose new pieces and dances to the new tones, have the singers learn them by heart, and establish them as the permanent standard of our age—to honor the tradition of the six classical musics.
units.literal: If there are discrepancies, we request that this directorate, according to the new-method tones, separately compose musical chapters and dance pieces, have singers memorize and practice them, and make them the law of the age forever, to glorify the book of the six musics.

units.zh: 世宗覽奏，善之。
units.en: Emperor Shizong read the memorial and approved it.
units.literal: Shizong reviewed the memorial and approved it.

units.zh: 乃下詔曰：「禮樂之重，國家所先。
units.en: He then issued an edict: "Ritual and music are what the state must put first.
units.literal: He then issued an edict saying: "The weight of ritual and music is what the state puts first.

units.zh: 近朝以來，雅音廢墜，雖時運之多故，亦官守之因循。
units.en: In recent reigns court music has fallen into ruin—partly because of the turmoil of the times, but also because officials clung to routine.
units.literal: In recent courts elegant music has been abandoned and fallen; though there have been many vicissitudes of the times, it is also due to officials' routine conformity.

units.zh: 遂使擊拊之音，空留梗概；
units.en: so that the sounds of drums and clappers retain only a bare outline;
units.literal: thus the sounds of striking and clapping retain only a bare outline;

units.zh: 旋相之法，莫究指歸。
units.en: the method of rotating tonics—no one could trace its principles.
units.literal: the method of rotating tonics—no one could trace where it led.

units.zh: 樞密使王仆，博識古今，懸通律呂，討尋舊典，撰集新聲，定六代之正音，成一朝之盛事。
units.en: Privy Council Commissioner Wang Pu, learned in antiquity and the present, master of pitch and mode, has searched the old canons and compiled new music, restored the correct tones of six dynasties, and achieved a crowning accomplishment of our reign.
units.literal: Privy Council Commissioner Wang Pu is broadly learned in ancient and modern matters, thoroughly versed in pitches and notes, has sought old canons and compiled new sounds, fixed the correct tones of the six dynasties, and accomplished a grand event of the age.

units.zh: 其王樸所奏旋宮之法，宜依張昭等議狀行。
units.en: Wang Pu's method of circulatory tonality should be implemented as Zhang Zhao and his colleagues recommended.
units.literal: Wang Pu's presented method of circulatory tonality should be implemented according to the deliberation memorial of Zhang Zhao and others.

units.zh: 仍令有司依調制曲，其間或有疑滯，更委王樸裁酌施行。」
units.en: The responsible offices are to compose pieces according to the modes; any difficulties that arise are to be referred to Wang Pu for final decision."
units.literal: Let the responsible offices further compose pieces according to the modes; if there are doubts or delays in the process, entrust Wang Pu again to judge and implement."

units.zh: 自是雅樂之音，稍克諧矣。
